description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [50% Dualcast Spellblade]/[50% Dualcast Spellblade] and [Spellblade Quick Cast v2]/[Dualcast Spellblade] and [Spellblade High Quick Cast] to the user if 1/2/4+ FF5 allies are alive

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: 50% Dualcast Spellblade
description.text: 50% chance for Spellblade abilities to trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Spellblade Quick Cast v2
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Spellblade abilities

description.name: Spellblade High Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x3.00 for Spellblade abilities
